vintage: NSO Statistical Yearbook 2024; WorldPop 2025; ESA WorldCover 2021; IBTrACS

lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: WorldPop 2025 estimated residents in the hex (1 km pixels, constrained to built-up areas, adjusted to UN totals) ÷ the hex's 65 km².

lenses.name: Urban share
lenses.unit: share of residents living in urban areas
lenses.description: Urban population ÷ average population, 2024 (NSO). Urban follows Vietnam's administrative definition (wards and towns).

lenses.name: Growth
lenses.description: Average population 2024 ÷ 2019 − 1, by former province (NSO PX-Web V02.03-07).

lenses.name: Income
lenses.description: Average monthly income per person (Vietnam Household Living Standards Survey, 2024) × 12, converted at the World Bank 2024 rate.
lenses.note: Income per person, not per household.

lenses.name: GRDP per person
lenses.description: Gross regional domestic product per person, 2024, current prices (NSO), converted at the World Bank 2024 rate.
lenses.note: Counted where output is made: oil, mining and industrial provinces score high even where incomes are modest.

lenses.name: Poverty
lenses.description: Share of households poor by Vietnam's multidimensional poverty standard for 2022–2025 (income plus access to jobs, health, education, housing, water and sanitation, information), 2024 (NSO).

lenses.name: Inequality
lenses.description: Gini coefficient of per-person income, 2024 (NSO, VHLSS). 0 = everyone earns the same.

lenses.name: Foreign investment
lenses.description: Newly registered plus added foreign direct investment capital in 2024 ÷ population (NSO). Provinces with no registration in 2024 are 0.
lenses.note: Registered capital, not money disbursed; one large project can dominate a province's year.

lenses.name: Trained workers
lenses.unit: workers 15+ with vocational or higher training
lenses.description: Share of the labour force aged 15+ holding a vocational certificate, college or university degree, 2024 (NSO Labour Force Survey).

lenses.name: Literacy
lenses.unit: people 15+ who can read and write
lenses.description: Literacy rate of people aged 15 and over, 2024 (NSO).

lenses.name: Human development
lenses.description: Human Development Index by province, 2024 (NSO): health, education and income combined, 0–1.

lenses.name: Unemployment
lenses.unit: unemployed share of the working-age labour force
lenses.description: Unemployment rate of the labour force in working age, 2024 (NSO Labour Force Survey).
lenses.note: Low everywhere: informal work absorbs most people who lose a job.

lenses.name: Productivity
lenses.description: Labour productivity: GRDP ÷ employed workers, 2024 (NSO), converted at the World Bank 2024 rate.

lenses.name: Business climate
lenses.description: Provincial Competitiveness Index 2022 (VCCI/USAID), the last year scored for all 63 provinces: a survey of private firms on transparency, costs, land access and governance.

lenses.name: Typhoons
lenses.description: Distinct tropical cyclones of at least tropical-storm strength (34 kt, WMO or JTWC winds) whose IBTrACS best track passed within 100 km of the hex centre, 1980 to today.
lenses.note: Counts storm passages, not damage: floods and landslides from storms that pass further away are not counted.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that ESA WorldCover 2021 classes as forest.

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that ESA WorldCover 2021 classes as farmland.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that ESA WorldCover 2021 classes as built-up.

lenses.name: Wetland & mangrove
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that ESA WorldCover 2021 classes as wetland & mangrove.
